entries.t: <FACE:80>It's good for you, but<NL>it's hard work-robo!
<FACE:75>Heh heh heh… cough<NL>Behold this sunlight…<WAIT>This greenery… I built<NL>it to heal my body!<WAIT><FACE:76>This Block will never…<NL>cough… be yours!!
<FACE:75>Hm? What, come to beg<NL>for your lives?<WAIT><FACE:00>No, not that… If your<NL>health comes first,<WAIT>forget space, live in<NL>the country on Earth?
<FACE:75>…No. Conquering space<NL>has its own romance!<WAIT>Frail or not, I won't<NL>give up space! cough<WAIT><FACE:04>…Well… I guess you're<NL>right about that…
<FACE:0A>Don't push yourself…<NL><WAIT>We may be enemies, but<NL>we do worry about you
<FACE:76>C…curse you…<NL>Pitied by children!!<WAIT>My dignity has fallen<NL>to the ground!<NL><WAIT>Then we settle this<NL>with a Robattle!<NL><WAIT>I'll show you how<NL>strong I am! …cough!!
<FACE:77>Grr… then I fall back…<NL>cough<WAIT><FACE:75>and… cough… regroup<NL>my forces!<NL>
<FACE:75>…But don't think I'll<NL>hand this over free…
